test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, BUTTER is written as 2212020518, MINED is written as 1391454. How will OIL be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

BUTTER is written as 2212020518

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4335c88d7b4c633365484039c5437bd0456dab8c64c65ea76b03f888f243ec.png] 

And,

MINED is written as 1391454

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ac9b2b3fd3db8cbd881b2f05616fc94caabdc1a7da733b5fa82fbec8ee1ac49.png] 

Similarly,

OIL will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a02c390fc16dd8a91cc1381990aba0c222f17df214a92abf7a4fab849274f8e.png] 

Hence,**15912** is the** correct answer.**
